name: Junkyard Titan / Junkyard Titan 2 / Junkyard Titan 3

values.meaning: Heat lost per second once decay starts
values.quote: decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds
values.binNote: Bin stores the decay as -10 (a per-second delta applied to Heat); the wiki states the same rate as a positive magnitude of 10 Heat/s lost. Same number, opposite sign convention.

values.meaning: Heat required to enter Danger Zone (empowers basic abilities)
values.quote: mech enters the ''Danger Zone'' when at or above {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}

values.meaning: Heat at which Rumble becomes Overheated (abilities disabled, on-hit empowered)
Duration Overheated status lasts (abilities disabled) while Heat decays to 0
values.quote: disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds

values.meaning: Bonus attack speed gained while Overheated
Bonus on-hit magic damage while Overheated
values.quote: deal {{pp|5 + (40-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

values.meaning: Cap on the target-max-health-ratio portion of the Overheated on-hit damage against monsters
values.quote: The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|65+((150-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}
values.binNote: No RumbleHeatSystem data value carries this 65-to-150 monster cap; the only monster-cap-like row on this class, RumbleHeatSystem.MonsterCap, is a flat 80 (a different, unrelated cap), and RumbleFlameThrower#MonsterCap (65 to 300 by level) belongs to Q's own monster cap, not the passive's. Not matched in the sheet; reported as a gap rather than resolved by guessing.

mechanics.claim: Basic ability casts generate Heat, which decays only after 4 seconds without a basic ability cast (or 2 seconds without casting R).
mechanics.quote: '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: While Overheated, all of Rumble's basic abilities (Q/W/E/R) are disabled for the duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Rumble's''' mech becomes ''Overheated'', disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: The Overheated bonus on-hit damage and attack speed do not apply against structures.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: Danger Zone (>=50 Heat) empowers Rumble's basic abilities (Q/W/E), a separate state from Overheated.
mechanics.quote: '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'', empowering his basic abilities.
